Case Study

Saving Time, Strengthening Messaging: How Grammarly’s AI Helps Iterable Work Smarter

March 12, 2025

93%

of communications improved

1.8

hours saved weekly per user

250%

increase in response rate from outreach to media

Iterable is an AI-powered customer communication platform that helps brands deliver individualized cross-channel communications at scale.

Trouble Maintaining Brand Voice Across Remote Teams

Lauren Kopulsky, Iterable’s Director of Communications, and her team are responsible for managing nearly all of the company’s messaging. Kopulsky often switches between internal and external communications daily and even ghostwrites for executives. She faces the constant challenge of maintaining Iterable’s voice for different stakeholders, striking the right tone across various channels, and ensuring message consistency.

However, the communication challenges at Iterable go beyond Kopulsky’s team. With a thoughtfully hybrid workplace (nearly 70% of Iterable’s employees are remote), the company is always trying to improve how it communicates internally and cross-functionally across different teams, platforms, and time zones. The marketing and support teams in particular find it challenging to translate complex technical material from the product and engineering teams into clear, customer-friendly language at the speed and scale required.

AI that Fits Seamlessly into Workflows

Kopulsky, and many other teams at Iterable, have turned to Grammarly to solve for Iterable’s various communication challenges. With Grammarly seamlessly integrated into their workflows, teams can refine customer-facing materials, enhance cross-functional collaboration, and maintain a high standard of communication at scale.

Kopulsky especially appreciated this seamless integration. In her role, timing and speed in decision-making and response are critical. Unlike other AI tools that she found disruptive and cumbersome because you had to switch between tabs to use them, Grammarly integrated directly into her existing workflows. This easy integration and the widespread availability of Grammarly’s AI made it an effortless addition to her tech stack.

The benefits of using Grammarly while writing were immediate. “It’s nice to have prompts already in Grammarly for tone so I don’t have that mental overload when I’m working with it,” Kopulsky said. “It’s a de-stressor because it’s simple and straightforward, and I know it’s going to work.”

With Grammarly, the Iterable marketing team can easily adjust the tone to align with Iterable’s audience and brand voice, significantly reducing time spent editing. The tool’s tone detector and AI-powered suggestions also help translate complex technical language into customer-friendly content, alleviating pressure on technical teams.

“I’ve found Grammarly immensely helpful when I’m discussing something technical with internal audiences or customers,” said Jeanette Woodburn, Senior Marketing Operations Manager at Iterable. “Having to go back and forth less on technical requests saves a lot of time, and I also appreciate being able to more clearly explain my work to various stakeholders.

International team members also use Grammarly to bridge communication gaps caused by cultural and geographical differences. “I mostly use it for two things: first, to refine my word-vomit Slack messages to give them more clarity, and second, to spot the differences between British and American English,” said Katie Gray, a Senior Integrated Marketing Manager based in the U.K. “As a Brit, who writes copy for both UK and American audiences, I rely on Grammarly to catch sneaky differences swapping an ‘s’ for a ‘z’ or making sure I write ‘learned’ instead of ‘learnt.’”

“Working Faster and Better” With Grammarly

Grammarly is helping Iterable employees improve the vast majority (93%) of their communications, giving users like Kopulsky nearly two hours back every week. This time savings enables employees to focus on higher-value work while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

The results prove the ROI of Grammarly to decision-makers at Iterable. “To an executive audience, having me be 1.5x of myself every day is very valuable,” said Kopulsky. “Grammarly is like having another person on my team making sure I’m working faster and better.”

Grammarly’s AI features have also improved results in media outreach campaigns. Kopulsky uses them to craft nuanced subject lines for pitches to analysts and journalists, significantly boosting her response rate. When sending 20 pitches with the same subject line, she might receive one or two responses. By tailoring subject lines with Grammarly, she now averages five to seven responses, increasing engagement by 250%.

“To an executive audience, having me be 1.5 of myself every day is very valuable. Grammarly is like having another person on my team making sure I’m working faster and better.”
Lauren Kopulsky
Director of Communications, Iterable

Across Iterable, Grammarly has reduced the time employees spend on internal communications by up to 40%. In addition to enhancing speed, Grammarly ensures consistent messaging and tone in every message. “Every single one of the faster messages I send is exactly the level of professionalism it needs to be for the audience,” Kopulsky said.

Neil Smith, Iterable’s VP of Technical Support, also sees the value of Grammarly in enhancing external communication. Smith’s technical support team has thousands of interactions with customers each year. “Customer satisfaction is a huge priority for us and Grammarly is helping us get there. It has been really helpful in building the skillset of our team members when it comes to the quality of their written communication,” Smith said.

Grammarly has also become a critical part of Iterable’s broader AI adoption strategy. The tool’s ease of onboarding and compliance with legal requirements made it a quick win for the company. “At Iterable, AI is at the core of what we do—we’re focused on helping our customers leverage our AI innovations to elevate their marketing and customer relationships. Grammarly has helped us bring that vision to life internally, making AI-powered communication a seamless part of how we work,” said Kopulsky.

Smarter March 12, 2025 ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ 93% of communications improved 1.8 hours saved weekly per user 250% increase in response rate from outreach to media Iterable is an AI-powered customer communication platform that helps brands deliver individualized cross-channel communications at scale. Trouble Maintaining Brand Voice Across Remote Teams Lauren Kopulsky, Iterable’s Director of Communications, and her team are responsible for managing nearly all of the company’s messaging. Kopulsky often switches between internal and external communications daily and even ghostwrites for executives. She faces the constant challenge of maintaining Iterable’s voice for different stakeholders, striking the right tone across various channels, and ensuring message consistency. However, the communication challenges at Iterable go beyond Kopulsky’s team. With a thoughtfully hybrid workplace (nearly 70% of Iterable’s employees are remote), the company is always trying to improve how it communicates internally and cross-functionally across different teams, platforms, and time zones. The marketing and support teams in particular find it challenging to translate complex technical material from the product and engineering teams into clear, customer-friendly language at the speed and scale required. AI that Fits Seamlessly into Workflows Kopulsky, and many other teams at Iterable, have turned to Grammarly to solve for Iterable’s various communication challenges. With Grammarly seamlessly integrated into their workflows, teams can refine customer-facing materials, enhance cross-functional collaboration, and maintain a high standard of communication at scale. Kopulsky especially appreciated this seamless integration. In her role, timing and speed in decision-making and response are critical. Unlike other AI tools that she found disruptive and cumbersome because you had to switch between tabs to use them, Grammarly integrated directly into her existing workflows. This easy integration and the widespread availability of Grammarly’s AI made it an effortless addition to her tech stack. The benefits of using Grammarly while writing were immediate. “It’s nice to have prompts already in Grammarly for tone so I don’t have that mental overload when I’m working with it,” Kopulsky said. “It’s a de-stressor because it’s simple and straightforward, and I know it’s going to work.” With Grammarly, the Iterable marketing team can easily adjust the tone to align with Iterable’s audience and brand voice, significantly reducing time spent editing. The tool’s tone detector and AI-powered suggestions also help translate complex technical language into customer-friendly content, alleviating pressure on technical teams. “I’ve found Grammarly immensely helpful when I’m discussing something technical with internal audiences or customers,” said Jeanette Woodburn, Senior Marketing Operations Manager at Iterable. “Having to go back and forth less on technical requests saves a lot of time, and I also appreciate being able to more clearly explain my work to various stakeholders. International team members also use Grammarly to bridge communication gaps caused by cultural and geographical differences. “I mostly use it for two things: first, to refine my word-vomit Slack messages to give them more clarity, and second, to spot the differences between British and American English,” said Katie Gray, a Senior Integrated Marketing Manager based in the U.K. “As a Brit, who writes copy for both UK and American audiences, I rely on Grammarly to catch sneaky differences swapping an ‘s’ for a ‘z’ or making sure I write ‘learned’ instead of ‘learnt.’” “Working Faster and Better” With Grammarly Grammarly is helping Iterable employees improve the vast majority (93%) of their communications, giving users like Kopulsky nearly two hours back every week. This time savings enables employees to focus on higher-value work while maintaining accuracy and professionalism. The results prove the ROI of Grammarly to decision-makers at Iterable. “To an executive audience, having me be 1.5x of myself every day is very valuable,” said Kopulsky. “Grammarly is like having another person on my team making sure I’m working faster and better.” Grammarly’s AI features have also improved results in media outreach campaigns. Kopulsky uses them to craft nuanced subject lines for pitches to analysts and journalists, significantly boosting her response rate. When sending 20 pitches with the same subject line, she might receive one or two responses. By tailoring subject lines with Grammarly, she now averages five to seven responses, increasing engagement by 250%. “To an executive audience, having me be 1.5 of myself every day is very valuable. Grammarly is like having another person on my team making sure I’m working faster and better.” Lauren Kopulsky Director of Communications, Iterable Across Iterable, Grammarly has reduced the time employees spend on internal communications by up to 40%. In addition to enhancing speed, Grammarly ensures consistent messaging and tone in every message. “Every single one of the faster messages I send is exactly the level of professionalism it needs to be for the audience,” Kopulsky said. Neil Smith, Iterable’s VP of Technical Support, also sees the value of Grammarly in enhancing external communication. Smith’s technical support team has thousands of interactions with customers each year. “Customer satisfaction is a huge priority for us and Grammarly is helping us get there. It has been really helpful in building the skillset of our team members when it comes to the quality of their written communication,” Smith said. Grammarly has also become a critical part of Iterable’s broader AI adoption strategy. The tool’s ease of onboarding and compliance with legal requirements made it a quick win for the company. “At Iterable, AI is at the core of what we do—we’re focused on helping our customers leverage our AI innovations to elevate their marketing and customer relationships. Grammarly has helped us bring that vision to life internally, making AI-powered communication a seamless part of how we work,” said Kopulsky. Interested in how Grammarly can help your team be more efficient and accurate? Contact us to learn more.             function getOptanonGroupsMapping() {
              var cookie = document.cookie.split('; ').find(function(row) { return row.startsWith('OptanonConsent='); });
              if (!cookie) return null;
              
              var optanonValue = decodeURIComponent(cookie.substring('OptanonConsent='.length));
              var groupsMatch = optanonValue.match(/groups=([^&]+)/);
              if (!groupsMatch) return null;
              
              var groupsStr = groupsMatch[1];
              var groups = {};
              groupsStr.split(',').forEach(function(pair) {
                var parts = pair.split(':');
                var category = parts[0];
                var value = parts[1];
                groups[category] = value === '1' ? 'accepted' : 'declined';
              });
              
              return groups;
            }
            
            function getOptanonConsentState(groupId) {
              var groups = getOptanonGroupsMapping();
              if (!groups) return null;
              
              var groupState = groups[groupId];
              if (!groupState) return null;
              
              return groupState === 'accepted';
            }
            
            function isUserInUSRegion() {
              if (!window.airgap.getRegimes) {
                return false;
              }
              
              try {
                var regimes = window.airgap.getRegimes();
                return regimes && regimes.has('USA');
              } catch (error) {
                return false;
              }
            }
            
            function getMigrationStatus() {
              try {
                var stored = localStorage.getItem('transcend_onetrust_migration_status');
                return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : null;
              } catch (error) {
                return null;
              }
            }
            
            function setMigrationStatus(consentState, migrated) {
              try {
                var status = {
                  migrated: migrated,
                  migratedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                  oneTrustConsentHash: 'C0004:' + (consentState ? '1' : '0')
                };
                localStorage.setItem('transcend_onetrust_migration_status', JSON.stringify(status));
              } catch (error) {
                // Silent error handling
              }
            }
            
            function shouldMigrate(consentState) {
              var migrationStatus = getMigrationStatus();
              if (!migrationStatus || !migrationStatus.migrated) {
                return true;
              }
              
              var currentHash = 'C0004:' + (consentState ? '1' : '0');
              return migrationStatus.oneTrustConsentHash !== currentHash;
            }
            
            function hasTranscendConsentSet() {
              if (!window.airgap || !window.airgap.getConsent) {
                return false;
              }
              
              try {
                var currentConsent = window.airgap.getConsent();
                if (!currentConsent) {
                  return false;
                }
                
                if (currentConsent.updated) {
                  return true;
                }
                
                return false;
              } catch (error) {
                return false;
              }
            }
            
            function performConsentMigration(trustedEvent) {
              if (!window.airgap || !window.airgap.setConsent) {
                return false;
              }
              
              try {
                if (!isUserInUSRegion()) {
                  document.removeEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);
                  return false;
                }

                // OneTrust OptanonConsent Cookie - C0004 group (Advertising)
                var c0004ConsentState = getOptanonConsentState('C0004');
                if (c0004ConsentState === null) {
                  document.removeEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);
                  return false;
                }
                
                if (!shouldMigrate(c0004ConsentState)) {
                  document.removeEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);
                  return false;
                }
                
                var hasConsentSet = hasTranscendConsentSet();
                if (hasConsentSet) {
                  document.removeEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);
                  return false;
                }
                
                var transcendConsent = {
                  Advertising: c0004ConsentState
                };
                window.airgap.setConsent(trustedEvent, transcendConsent);
                setMigrationStatus(c0004ConsentState, true);
                
                document.removeEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);
                
                return true;
              } catch (error) {
                return false;
              }
            }

            document.addEventListener('click', performConsentMigration);

Clear communication fuels results that speak for themselves, whether in a winning sales pitch, an essay that makes the grade, or a message that strikes exactly the right tone. Our linguists and researchers work at the frontier of natural language processing and generative AI, with one goal in mind: to help people write with more clarity, more confidence, and a voice that's entirely their own. Everything you need, wherever you write Grammarly works across more than 1 million apps and websites, so help is always there when you need it. AI writing agents refine your tone, suggest rewrites, and help make your arguments land. And when you want a focused space to write from scratch, docs gives you a distraction-free home with all the assistance built right in. Grammarly Free helps anyone write with confidence. Grammarly Pro helps professionals and teams make every message more effective. Grammarly for Education gives students and institutions campus-wide access to writing support that builds real communication skills, both inside and beyond the classroom. Grammarly is now a part of the Superhuman Suite . Our journey so far In 2009, Max Lytvyn, Alex Shevchenko, and Dmytro Lider founded Grammarly with a simple goal: help people communicate more effectively. What began as a grammar checker for students grew into something much bigger: a trusted AI partner helping millions express their ideas with clarity and confidence. Over time, Grammarly evolved from a writing assistant into an AI-powered communication platform that works everywhere people write. It has become so seamless that most users don’t even think of it as AI. It is just part of how work gets done. In 2025, we acquired Coda and Superhuman Mail, marking the start of Grammarly’s next evolution. In October, our company became Superhuman. The new name unites all three products under one brand and one mission. Grammarly remains at the core, continuing to help millions find the right words. Superhuman represents what comes next: an AI-native productivity platform built to unlock the best in everyone. We're building on 16 years of learning: that AI works best when it feels effortless, and that technology should make people more capable, not replace them. That belief started everything. And now, with Superhuman, that power is everywhere you work. Learn more at Superhuman.com → Write the future with us Join us in bringing powerful, human-centered AI to everyone who has something worth saying.
